posts.text: Every second counts for those in need of help calling 911. Imagine being in life threatening danger and having to be put on wait, with an automated message that tells you to hang up if you are not in an emergency. Call takers are first come first serve; if no one picks up, you are put in a queue ordered by the time you dialed, not by urgency. What if we could reduce the maximum wait time?
